rubric.summary: 满分 5 分（建议 3–4 句完整英文），按内容要点、句型语法、拼写大小写与标点分四档评分。

tiers.criteria: 要点齐全，语法与时态准确，句式自然多样，大小写、拼写和标点规范。
覆盖主要内容，语句基本通顺，有 1–2 处小拼写或语法错误但不影响理解。
能写出部分句子，信息不够完整，语法或拼写错误较多。
仅写个别单词、偏题或无法成句。

answer.reference: I have a warm family of four: my father, my mother, my little brother and me. My dad is tall and my mum is nice. On weekends, we cook dinner and walk in the park together. I love my family!

question.solution: 【高分范文参考】I have a warm family of four: my father, my mother, my little brother and me. My dad is tall and my mum is nice. On weekends, we cook dinner and walk in the park together. I love my family!

explanation.steps:
【标准讲解】【高分范文参考】I have a warm family of four: my father, my mother, my little brother and me. My dad is tall and my mum is nice. On weekends, we cook dinner and walk in the park together. I love my family!
评分要点（一档（优秀） 7–8分）：要点齐全，语法与时态准确，句式自然多样，大小写、拼写和标点规范。
explanation.pitfall: 【易错提醒】书写时检查首字母大写、词间距与句末标点，尤其注意第三人称单数动词变化与时态前后一致。

rubric.summary: 满分 8 分（建议 4–5 句连贯短文（约 30 词）），按内容要点、句型语法、拼写大小写与标点分四档评分。

tiers.criteria: 要点齐全，语法与时态准确，句式自然多样，大小写、拼写和标点规范。
覆盖主要内容，语句基本通顺，有 1–2 处小拼写或语法错误但不影响理解。
能写出部分句子，信息不够完整，语法或拼写错误较多。
仅写个别单词、偏题或无法成句。

explanation.pitfall: 【易错提醒】切勿仅凭字母拼写外观猜测，要结合自然拼读规律大声拼读验证发音是否一致。

answer.reference: My father is a doctor and my mother is a teacher. They work very hard every day. At home, I am a good helper. I sweep the floor, clean my desk and water the flowers on weekends. My parents are very proud of me!

question.solution: 【高分范文参考】My father is a doctor and my mother is a teacher. They work very hard every day. At home, I am a good helper. I sweep the floor, clean my desk and water the flowers on weekends. My parents are very proud of me!

评分要点（一档（优秀） 7–8分）：要点齐全，语法与时态准确，句式自然多样，大小写、拼写和标点规范。

能写出部分句子，信息不够完整，语法或拼写错误较多。
仅写个别单词、偏题或无法成句。

question.fineKpName: 英语单元主题书面表达
question.stem: 书面表达·My Best Friend（上学期素养表达）：结合四上 U2 主题，写 5 句短文描述你最好朋友的外貌、性格和共同爱好。

answer.reference: My best friend is Zhang Peng. He is tall and strong with short black hair. He is very kind and always helps classmates with maths. After school, we often play basketball and read science books together. I am lucky to have him as my friend!

question.solution: 【高分范文参考】My best friend is Zhang Peng. He is tall and strong with short black hair. He is very kind and always helps classmates with maths. After school, we often play basketball and read science books together. I am lucky to have him as my friend!

【标准讲解】【高分范文参考】My best friend is Zhang Peng. He is tall and strong with short black hair. He is very kind and always helps classmates with maths. After school, we often play basketball and read science books together. I am lucky to have him as my friend!

explanation.pitfall: 【易错提醒】书写时检查首字母大写、词间距与句末标点，尤其注意第三人称单数动词变化与时态前后一致。

rubric.summary: 满分 8 分（建议 4–5 句连贯短文（约 30 词）），按内容要点、句型语法、拼写大小写与标点分四档评分。

能写出部分句子，信息不够完整，语法或拼写错误较多。
仅写个别单词、偏题或无法成句。

question.fineKpName: 英语单元主题书面表达
question.stem: 书面表达·My Favourite Teacher（上学期素养表达）：结合五上 U1 主题，写一篇 50 词左右的短文介绍你最喜欢的老师（学科、性格、课堂特色）。

answer.reference: My favourite teacher is Miss Wang, our English teacher. She is young, kind and very humorous. Her classes are always lively with songs, games and interesting stories. Whenever we feel shy to speak English, she smiles and encourages us patiently. We all love her very much!

question.solution: 【高分范文参考】My favourite teacher is Miss Wang, our English teacher. She is young, kind and very humorous. Her classes are always lively with songs, games and interesting stories. Whenever we feel shy to speak English, she smiles and encourages us patiently. We all love her very much!

explanation.kpFocus: 【考点定位】人教PEP英语五上·Unit 1 Different friends·英语单元主题书面表达
explanation.hint: 【课堂思路提示】先审清写作主题、人称和时态，围绕“开头引入—2至3句核心细节—结尾感受”写出 4–6 句规范英文。
explanation.steps:
【标准讲解】【高分范文参考】My favourite teacher is Miss Wang, our English teacher. She is young, kind and very humorous. Her classes are always lively with songs, games and interesting stories. Whenever we feel shy to speak English, she smiles and encourages us patiently. We all love her very much!
评分要点（一档（优秀） 7–8分）：要点齐全，语法与时态准确，句式自然多样，大小写、拼写和标点规范。
explanation.pitfall: 【易错提醒】书写时检查首字母大写、词间距与句末标点，尤其注意第三人称单数动词变化与时态前后一致。

rubric.summary: 满分 8 分（建议 5–7 句完整语篇（45–60 词）），按内容要点、句型语法、拼写大小写与标点分四档评分。

tiers.criteria: 要点齐全，语法与时态准确，句式自然多样，大小写、拼写和标点规范。
覆盖主要内容，语句基本通顺，有 1–2 处小拼写或语法错误但不影响理解。
能写出部分句子，信息不够完整，语法或拼写错误较多。
仅写个别单词、偏题或无法成句。

question.fineKpName: 英语单元主题书面表达
question.stem: 书面表达·My Healthy Habits（上学期素养表达）：结合五上 U4/U5 主题，写一篇 50 词短文介绍你的健康运动、作息与饮食习惯。

answer.reference: Healthy habits make me strong and energetic every day. I get up early and jog for fifteen minutes every morning. For meals, I eat plenty of fresh vegetables, fruit, fish and whole grains, and seldom drink sweet soda. I always go to bed before 9:30 to get nine hours of sleep.

question.solution: 【高分范文参考】Healthy habits make me strong and energetic every day. I get up early and jog for fifteen minutes every morning. For meals, I eat plenty of fresh vegetables, fruit, fish and whole grains, and seldom drink sweet soda. I always go to bed before 9:30 to get nine hours of sleep.

explanation.kpFocus: 【考点定位】人教PEP英语五上·Unit 3 Work and play·英语单元主题书面表达
explanation.hint: 【课堂思路提示】先审清写作主题、人称和时态，围绕“开头引入—2至3句核心细节—结尾感受”写出 4–6 句规范英文。
explanation.steps:
【标准讲解】【高分范文参考】Healthy habits make me strong and energetic every day. I get up early and jog for fifteen minutes every morning. For meals, I eat plenty of fresh vegetables, fruit, fish and whole grains, and seldom drink sweet soda. I always go to bed before 9:30 to get nine hours of sleep.
评分要点（一档（优秀） 7–8分）：要点齐全，语法与时态准确，句式自然多样，大小写、拼写和标点规范。
explanation.pitfall: 【易错提醒】书写时检查首字母大写、词间距与句末标点，尤其注意第三人称单数动词变化与时态前后一致。

rubric.summary: 满分 8 分（建议 5–7 句完整语篇（45–60 词）），按内容要点、句型语法、拼写大小写与标点分四档评分。

tiers.criteria: 要点齐全，语法与时态准确，句式自然多样，大小写、拼写和标点规范。
覆盖主要内容，语句基本通顺，有 1–2 处小拼写或语法错误但不影响理解。
能写出部分句子，信息不够完整，语法或拼写错误较多。
仅写个别单词、偏题或无法成句。

question.fineKpName: PEP Phonics 自然拼读（-y 词尾发 /i/）
question.stem: 自然拼读辨音（cl / pl 辅音连缀）：选出下列单词中画线/核心字母发音不同的一项。
question.solution: clock、clean、clever 都符合「cl / pl 辅音连缀 → cl / pl 清晰连读」拼读规律，只有 cat 发音不同。

explanation.kpFocus: 【考点定位】人教PEP英语五下·Unit 1 Following the rules·PEP Phonics 自然拼读（-y 词尾发 /i/）

explanation.steps: 【标准讲解】clock、clean、clever 都符合「cl / pl 辅音连缀 → cl / pl 清晰连读」拼读规律，只有 cat 发音不同。 参考答案：D（cat）。
explanation.pitfall: 【易错提醒】切勿仅凭字母拼写外观猜测，要结合自然拼读规律大声拼读验证发音是否一致。

question.stem: 自然拼读辨音（cl / pl 辅音连缀）：选出下列单词中画线/核心字母发音不同的一项。

explanation.steps: 【标准讲解】class、plate、clever 都符合「cl / pl 辅音连缀 → cl / pl 清晰连读」拼读规律，只有 cup 发音不同。 参考答案：C（cup）。
explanation.pitfall: 【易错提醒】切勿仅凭字母拼写外观猜测，要结合自然拼读规律大声拼读验证发音是否一致。

group.title: 情景补全对话（五选五）：Saving Energy at Home
group.passage:
Amy: Our teacher asked us to make a 'Green Home' poster. (1) ______
Lin Tao: Great idea! First, we can turn off lights when leaving a room.
Amy: Right! (2) ______
Lin Tao: We should reuse water from washing vegetables to water plants.
Amy: Smart! What about going to school or shopping?
Lin Tao: (3) ______ And always bring reusable cloth bags.
Amy: (4) ______
Lin Tao: Because plastic bags pollute rivers and take hundreds of years to break down.
Amy: Let's draw a bright green Earth in the middle of our poster!
Lin Tao: (5) ______

A. How can we save water at home?
B. What green habits should we write on it?
C. We can walk, ride bikes or take the subway.
D. Why should we use fewer plastic bags?
E. Perfect! Everyone will love our poster!

group.title: 听力短文：Smart Pocket Money Plan
group.audioScript: Twelve-year-old Mei gets 100 yuan of lucky money this month. Instead of spending it all on snacks, she uses a smart 'three-jar' plan. She puts 50 yuan into her savings jar for a new dictionary, spends 30 yuan on stationery she needs, and gives 20 yuan to help stray animals. Managing money well helps her grow independent.

Some of them laugh at a lame (脚疾) or blind (盲) person, or someone in bad clothes. but as they grow up, they learn not to hurt people's feelings by laughing at their problems. answer.reference: Learning to manage pocket money is a useful life skill. Every month, I divide my pocket money into three parts. I save half of it for buying good books, spend thirty percent on stationery I truly need, and put twenty percent aside to help children or stray animals in need. Smart budgeting makes me responsible!

group.title: 听力短文：My Unforgettable Holiday in Xi'an
group.audioScript: Over the winter holiday, John went to Xi'an with his parents by high-speed train. On the first day, they visited the Terracotta Army and took lots of photos. On the second day, John rode a bike on the ancient City Wall and ate delicious noodles. He bought a small clay warrior gift for his best friend Mike.

group.title: 情景补全对话（五选五）：Then and Now Before Graduation
group.passage:
Grandpa: Look at this old photo of your school from 30 years ago!
Wu Binbin: Wow, it looks so different! (1) ______
Grandpa: No, there wasn't. We only had a small dirt playground.
Wu Binbin: (2) ______
Grandpa: No, there were no computers or Internet at all! We looked up words in paper dictionaries.
Wu Binbin: How about you in primary school? (3) ______
Grandpa: Yes, I could! I rode my bike 5 kilometres to school every day.
Wu Binbin: You're awesome! I have changed a lot too since Grade 1. (4) ______
Grandpa: I'm so proud of you! Middle school is waiting for you.
Wu Binbin: (5) ______

【备选句子 Options】
A. Were there any computers in your classroom?
B. Was there a big gym back then?
C. Could you ride a bike when you were twelve?
D. Before I was quiet, now I am active and confident.
E. Thank you, Grandpa! I'll keep working hard!

question.fineKpName: 英语单元主题书面表达
question.stem: 书面表达·My Unforgettable Holiday Trip（下学期拓展表达）：结合六下 U3 主题，用一般过去时写一篇 55–65 词短文记叙一次难忘的假期旅行（地点、交通、活动、感受）。

answer.reference: Last summer holiday, I went to Guilin with my parents by high-speed train. The mountains and clear green water looked just like a Chinese ink painting! We took a bamboo raft along the Li River, took many photos and ate delicious Guilin rice noodles. I also bought nice gifts for my friends. It was an unforgettable trip!

question.solution: 【高分范文参考】Last summer holiday, I went to Guilin with my parents by high-speed train. The mountains and clear green water looked just like a Chinese ink painting! We took a bamboo raft along the Li River, took many photos and ate delicious Guilin rice noodles. I also bought nice gifts for my friends. It was an unforgettable trip!

explanation.steps:
【标准讲解】【高分范文参考】Last summer holiday, I went to Guilin with my parents by high-speed train. The mountains and clear green water looked just like a Chinese ink painting! We took a bamboo raft along the Li River, took many photos and ate delicious Guilin rice noodles. I also bought nice gifts for my friends. It was an unforgettable trip!

explanation.pitfall: 【易错提醒】书写时检查首字母大写、词间距与句末标点，尤其注意第三人称单数动词变化与时态前后一致。

rubric.summary: 满分 8 分（建议 5–7 句完整语篇（45–60 词）），按内容要点、句型语法、拼写大小写与标点分四档评分。

能写出部分句子，信息不够完整，语法或拼写错误较多。

group.title: Reading B: Smart Budget for a Class Farewell Party（6年级下册）
group.passage: Grade 6 Class 1 is planning a graduation farewell party with a budget of 300 yuan. question.fineKpName: 英语单元主题书面表达
question.stem: 书面表达·My Unforgettable Holiday Trip（下学期拓展表达）：结合六下 U3 主题，用一般过去时写一篇 55–65 词短文记叙一次难忘的假期旅行（地点、交通、活动、感受）。

answer.reference: Last summer holiday, I went to Guilin with my parents by high-speed train. The mountains and clear green water looked just like a Chinese ink painting! We took a bamboo raft along the Li River, took many photos and ate delicious Guilin rice noodles. I also bought nice gifts for my friends. It was an unforgettable trip!

question.solution: 【高分范文参考】Last summer holiday, I went to Guilin with my parents by high-speed train. The mountains and clear green water looked just like a Chinese ink painting! We took a bamboo raft along the Li River, took many photos and ate delicious Guilin rice noodles. I also bought nice gifts for my friends. It was an unforgettable trip!

explanation.kpFocus: 【考点定位】人教PEP英语六下·Unit 4 Then and now·英语单元主题书面表达
explanation.hint: 【课堂思路提示】先审清写作主题、人称和时态，围绕“开头引入—2至3句核心细节—结尾感受”写出 4–6 句规范英文。
explanation.steps:
【标准讲解】【高分范文参考】Last summer holiday, I went to Guilin with my parents by high-speed train. The mountains and clear green water looked just like a Chinese ink painting! We took a bamboo raft along the Li River, took many photos and ate delicious Guilin rice noodles. I also bought nice gifts for my friends. It was an unforgettable trip!
评分要点（一档（优秀） 7–8分）：要点齐全，语法与时态准确，句式自然多样，大小写、拼写和标点规范。
explanation.pitfall: 【易错提醒】书写时检查首字母大写、词间距与句末标点，尤其注意第三人称单数动词变化与时态前后一致。

rubric.summary: 满分 8 分（建议 5–7 句完整语篇（45–60 词）），按内容要点、句型语法、拼写大小写与标点分四档评分。

tiers.criteria: 要点齐全，语法与时态准确，句式自然多样，大小写、拼写和标点规范。
覆盖主要内容，语句基本通顺，有 1–2 处小拼写或语法错误但不影响理解。
能写出部分句子，信息不够完整，语法或拼写错误较多。
仅写个别单词、偏题或无法成句。
